name: delfiboyz.github.io
description: Portfolio + Live OSINT 3D globe. Sources in js/src, bundled to js/dist for GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: rm -rf js/dist && esbuild js/src/home.js js/src/osint.js js/src/wayback.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outdir=js/dist --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] --legal-comments=eof
